name: pomodoro
description: Pomodoro timer: a notification after a work block without a break, and a check-in where Claude stops to sum up and a menu asks whether to go on.

workMinutes.title: Work block (minutes)
workMinutes.description: Minutes of work before the break alert.

breakMinutes.title: Break (minutes)
breakMinutes.description: Minutes with no keyboard or mouse input that count as a break. The alert also repeats this often until you take one.

moveSeconds.title: Mouse movement that counts (seconds)
moveSeconds.description: Seconds the mouse has to keep moving to count as you being there (macOS). Anything shorter, like the nudge a keep-awake app's mouse jiggler gives every minute, neither holds off a break nor ends one. Keys, clicks and scrolls always count. 0 counts every movement.

sound.title: Chime
sound.description: Play a chime with each alert (macOS). You hear it through a Focus, and while the Claude tab is in front, where Ghostty shows the banner for a few seconds only.

checkIn.title: Check-in
checkIn.description: At the alert, Claude pauses and sums up what it did since the break, then a menu asks whether to go on.

emoji.title: Tomato emoji
emoji.description: Show 🍅 in the count, the status line, the toasts and the transcript note. Off, the footer count reads 'pomodoro 12/25m'.
